name: BodyContainer
description: Container for all bodies, accessed as O.bodies.

methods.name: append
methods.description: append( (BodyContainer)arg1, (Body)arg2) -> int : Append one Body instance, return its id. append( (BodyContainer)arg1, (object)arg2) -> object : Append list of Body instance, return list of

methods.name: appendClumped
methods.description: Append given list of bodies as a clump (rigid aggregate); returns a tuple of (clumpId,[memberId1,memberId2,...]). Clump masses and inertia are computed automatically depending upon *discretization* (for details see clump()).

methods.name: clump
methods.description: Clump given bodies together (creating a rigid aggregate); returns clumpId. A precise definition of clump masses and inertia when clump members overlap requires *discretization*>0 and is achieved in this case by integration/summation over mass points using a regular grid of cells (grid cells length is defined as $L_{min}/discretization$, where $L_{min}$ is the minimum length of an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box. If *discretization*<=0 sum of inertias from members is simply used, which is faster but accurate only for non-overlapping members).

methods.name: updateClumpProperties
methods.description: Manually force Yade to update clump properties mass, volume and inertia (for details of 'discretization' value see clump()). Can be used, when clumps are modified or erased during a simulation. Clumps can be excluded from the calculation by giving a list of ids: *O.bodies.updateProperties([ids])*.

methods.name: addToClump
methods.description: Add body b (or a list of bodies) to an existing clump c. c must be clump and b may not be a clump member of c. Clump masses and inertia are adapted automatically (for details see clump()). See :ysrc:`examples/clumps/addToClump-example.py` for an example script. .. note:: If b is a clump itself, then all members will be added to c and b will be deleted. If b is a clump member of clump d, then all members from d will be added to c and d will be deleted. If you need to add just clump member b, release this member from d first.

methods.name: releaseFromClump
methods.description: Release body b from clump c. b must be a clump member of c. Clump masses and inertia are adapted automatically (for details see clump()). See :ysrc:`examples/clumps/releaseFromClump-example.py` for an example script. .. note:: If c contains only 2 members b will not be released and a warning will appear. In this case clump c should be erased.

methods.name: replaceByClumps
methods.description: Replace spheres by clumps using a list of clump templates and a list of amounts; returns a list of tuples: [(clumpId1,[memberId1,memberId2,...]),(clumpId2,[memberId1,memberId2,...]),...]. A new clump will have the same volume as the sphere, that was replaced. Clump masses and inertia are adapted automatically (for details see clump()). *O.bodies.replaceByClumps( [utils.clumpTemplate([1,1],[.5,.5])] , [.9] ) #will replace 90 % of all standalone spheres by 'dyads'* See :ysrc:`examples/clumps/replaceByClumps-example.py` for an example script.

methods.name: getRoundness
methods.description: Returns roundness coefficient RC = R2/R1. R1 is the equivalent sphere radius of a clump. R2 is the minimum radius of a sphere, that imbeds the clump. If just spheres are present RC = 1. If clumps are present 0 < RC < 1. Bodies can be excluded from the calculation by giving a list of ids: *O.bodies.getRoundness([ids])*. See :ysrc:`examples/clumps/replaceByClumps-example.py` for an example script.
